decisions: golden: hand-written from brief-a.md; reasons for outcomes promise/paid are omitted (rule 46 table 'none')
golden: human request scoped to id/neg/conf (an unconfirmed right party is never transferred)

sources./opening/line: say you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and that the call is recorded
sources./bands/0: | 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1 |
sources./bands/1: | 8 to 45 | late | the 7th business day after today | 2 |
sources./required_sentences/0/text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

declared.name: customer_id
declared.meaning: Pass it to every tool call.

declared.name: title
declared.meaning: Mr or Ms; address as title plus last name.

declared.name: now
declared.meaning: Current date and time; all date rules use it.

opening.line: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from <bank>, and we record this call.

answers.why: I can only explain that to <customer>.
answers.other: I'm sorry, I need to know who I am speaking with first.

third_party.reach_ask: When would be a good time to reach <customer>?
third_party.reach_reask: Is there another time today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00, when I could reach <customer>?
third_party.outside_line: I'm sorry, I can only arrange a call back for today or the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00.
third_party.vague_line: Could you tell me the exact day and time?
third_party.booked_line: Thank you. We will call back on <date> at <time>.
third_party.offer_to_pay_line: Thank you, but I can only speak with <customer> about this.

questions.ask: Before we continue, could you please tell me your date of birth?
questions.reask_wrong: That does not match our records. Could you tell me your date of birth again?
questions.ask_full: Could you tell me your full date of birth, with the day, the month and the year?

questions.ask: Thank you. What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?
questions.reask_wrong: That does not match our records. Could you tell me the last four digits of your phone number again?
questions.ask_full: Could you give me all four of the last four digits of your phone number?

hints.say: Could you say the month of your date of birth as a word, please?

identity.fail_line: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

statement.intro: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
statement.item: Your <product> is <days_late> days late, with <past_due> past due.

below_floor.say: I'm afraid I can't record an amount below <floor>.

first_ask.single: Can you make this payment today?
first_ask.multi: Can you pay all of them today?

ladder.line: Could you pay at least <amount> by <date>?

intents.label: Customer has died
intents.description: The speaker says the customer has died.
negatives: My father died last year and I lost my job.

action.say: I am sorry for your loss.

intents.label: Number not the customer's
intents.description: The speaker says this phone number does not belong to the customer.
examples: Nobody by that name lives here.

intents.label: Hardship
intents.description: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
examples: I lost my job last month.

action.say: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
action.accept_say: I will connect you with our customer support team now.

intents.label: New plan or lower instalments
intents.description: The customer asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
examples: Can I get a new payment plan?

action.say: I will transfer you to our restructuring team.

intents.label: Debt not mine
intents.description: The customer denies the debt or the product, or says it was closed or paid off in the past.
examples: I never had a car loan.
I paid that loan off years ago.
negatives: I already paid this month's amount yesterday.

action.say: I understand. I won't take a promise for this.

intents.label: Already paid
intents.description: The customer says they have already paid this past-due amount.
negatives: I paid that loan off years ago.

action.say: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.

intents.label: Wants a human
intents.description: The customer asks to speak to a human or a real person.
examples: I want to talk to a real person.
Put me through to a human.

action.question: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with?
action.say: I will transfer you to a colleague.

intents.label: Does not want to talk
intents.description: The customer says they do not want to talk or wants to end the call.
examples: I don't want to talk to you.
negatives: I don't want to pay today.

action.say: I understand. It will only take a moment.

intents.label: Full amount too much
intents.description: The customer says the full amount is too much or they can only pay part of it.
examples: I can't pay all of that.
negatives: I lost my job and can't pay anything.

intents.label: Asks if robot
intents.description: The customer asks whether they are talking to a robot or an AI.

intents.label: Asks if scam
intents.description: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or fraud.
examples: How do I know this is really the bank?

action.say: You can verify this call by phoning <bank>'s customer service number.

intents.label: Change a recorded promise
intents.description: The customer asks to change or cancel a promise that was already recorded.
examples: Cancel the promise I just made.

action.say: A recorded promise cannot be changed in this call. You can change it in the mobile app.

intents.label: Asks for discount or waiver
intents.description: The customer asks for a discount, a waiver or a reduction of the debt.

action.say: I'm afraid I can't offer that.

multi_product.clamp_line: For your <product>, the latest date I can record is <deadline>, so I will use that date.

confirmation.question: Do you confirm?
confirmation.what_to_change: What would you like to change?
confirmation.recorded_cannot_change: A recorded promise cannot be changed in this call. You can change it in the mobile app.

recording.failed_item: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise for your <product>.
recording.failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.

required_sentences.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
I am sorry for your loss.

closing.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

lines.clarify: Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.date_ask_exact: Which exact day would work for you?
lines.next_bd_offer: That day is not a business day. Could you pay <amount> on <date> instead?
lines.deadline_offer: The latest date I can record is <deadline>. Could you pay <amount> by then?
lines.past_date: That date has already passed. Which day would work for you?
lines.floor_offer: I understand. Could you pay <floor> by <date>?
lines.above_full_offer: The amount past due is <past_due>. Shall I record <past_due>?
lines.pay_on_date_question: Would you like to pay on <date>?
lines.cannot_offer: I'm afraid I can't offer that.
lines.account_error: I'm sorry, I can't access the account details right now.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
